taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's rubber rabbitbrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-15): "typically reaches 12 to 90 inches (31-229 cm) in height"; some populations reach 10 to 12 feet (3.3-3.6 m).

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: FEIS's rubber rabbitbrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-15): "Plant spread is generally between 0.2 and 3.3 feet (0.6-1 m)".

traits.leaf_shape.note: FEIS's rubber rabbitbrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-15): "Leaves are linear".

traits.leaf_width_m.note: FEIS's rubber rabbitbrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-15): leaves "less than 0.04 inch (0.1 cm) wide", stated here as about 1 mm.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.capitulum_kind.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as the FEIS review read does not describe the heads; rabbitbrush heads have disc florets only.

traits.inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), seed ripens in autumn (FEIS, Tirmenstein 1999); the flowering months are the model's.

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS's rubber rabbitbrush review (Tirmenstein 1999, read 2026-10-16): near Millican, Oregon, "seed disseminated" early September to mid-November (it also says seed ripens "from late fall to early winter", late September at high elevations to late November in the Mojave); read as September to November.

generator.params.note: Brittlebush's values, changed by hand for rubber rabbitbrush: several upright stems from the base branching into a rounded bush (FEIS, Tirmenstein 1999), crowded thread-like leaves, and flat-topped clusters of small yellow heads at the stem tips. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.2 m at 12 years in the open, within FEIS's 31-229 cm; plants may be "full grown" within 4 years (Tirmenstein 1999). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: the grey form's felted grey-green stems and leaves (FEIS: "covered with a felt-like layer of trichomes"); golden-yellow heads. Leaves drawn on a narrow blade card (aspect 0.015), as no simple card draws one under 1 mm wide.
